references.text: Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering that is for himself and make atonement for himself and his household.

Aaron shall wash his body with water in a holy place, put on his regular garments, go out, and offer his burnt offering and the people's burnt offering, making atonement for himself and for the people.
He shall make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the tent of meeting, and for the altar. He shall also make atonement for the priests and for all the assembled people.
Aaron and his sons shall wear them when they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to serve in the sanctuary.
Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar with the blood of the sin offering; once a year he shall make atonement for it throughout their generations.
Only the high priest enters the second room, and only once a year, never without blood that he offers for himself and for the sins committed in ignorance by the people.
Christ did not enter a holy place made with hands, which is a copy of the true one, but entered heaven itself, now to appear in God's presence on our behalf.
Christ entered the holy place once for all, not by means of the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood, thus securing an eternal redemption.
